# Tauri command response fixtures

Every `*.json` in this directory is **generated by Rust**, not written by hand.
Each file is one realistic sample of what a `#[tauri::command]` returns,
serialized with serde exactly as Tauri sends it to the webview.

Source of truth: [`src-tauri/tests/response_fixtures.rs`](../../../src-tauri/tests/response_fixtures.rs)
(one `#[test]` per command, comparing bytes with the file here).

## Never hand-edit these files

`cargo test` compares each file byte-for-byte with a fresh serialization.
If a Rust response struct changes shape (a field rename, a `#[serde(rename)]`,
a new variant), the Rust test fails until you regenerate:

```bash
cd src-tauri
UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --test response_fixtures
```

Then update the TypeScript types in `src/lib/api/` and any Playwright mocks
that hand-write the same response. Commit the regenerated JSON together with
the Rust change.

## How the frontend uses them

`src/lib/api/*.contract.test.ts` (Vitest) imports these files and asserts they
satisfy the TypeScript response types, so a Rust rename that regenerates a
fixture fails `pnpm test` / `pnpm check` until the TS side follows.
Playwright E2E mocks may return these files instead of inline literals.

## Files

| File | Command | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `boot_status.ready.json` | `boot_status` | `state: "ready"` |
| `boot_status.recovery.json` | `boot_status` | `state: "recovery"` + `recovery_reason` |
| `app_info.json` | `app_info` | |
| `list_balances.json` | `list_balances` | archived account excluded from `total_assets` |
| `monthly_summary.json` | `monthly_summary` | |
| `monthly_series.json` | `monthly_series` | array, two months |
| `list_transactions.json` | `list_transactions` | income, expense, transfer |
| `list_categories.json` | `list_categories` | expense, income, archived |
| `list_accounts.json` | `list_accounts` | cash, bank, archived credit card |
| `list_budget_statuses.json` | `list_budget_statuses` | one under, one over budget |
| `list_top_budget_statuses.json` | `list_top_budget_statuses` | same type, ranked |
| `import_json.json` | `import_json` | one warning |
| `export_backup_to_file.json` | `export_backup_to_file` | the `Some` case; cancel returns `null` |
| `app_error.json` | any command (rejected `invoke`) | `AppError` is a plain string |
